4857.question_text: In the living cells, insufficient oxygen may cause a breakdown of glucose into?
4857.explanation:
Breakdown of glucose in the absence of oxygen is referred to as Anaerobic respiration.

For some organisms, such as yeast, the end product is ethanol,

while in others such as human muscle cells, the end product is lactic acid.

4888.subject: Biology
4888.question_text: When two heterozygotes mate, the dominant trait will appear in
4888.explanation: When two heterozygotes (genotype Aa) mate, the dominant trait will appear in both the F1 and F2 generations because dominant alleles mask recessive ones whenever they are present. F1 Generation: By definition, the F1 generation refers to the first set of offspring from a set of parents. In a cross of Aa x Aa, approximately 75% of the offspring will possess at least one dominant allele (AA or Aa) and will therefore display the dominant trait. F2 Generation: The F2 generation is produced by crossing members of the F1 generation. Since the F1 contains individuals with dominant alleles, their subsequent crosses will continue to produce offspring that express the dominant trait in the standard Mendelian 3:1 phenotypic ratio.

options.text: both the F<sub>1</sub> and F<sub>2</sub> generations
neither the F<sub>1</sub> nor F<sub>2</sub> generation

4894.subject: Biology
4894.question_text: Which of the following is likely to occur in a deciduous forest during the dry season?
4894.explanation: Trees in tropical deciduous forests lose their leaves in the dry season and regrow them in the rainy season. In temperate deciduous forests, trees lose their leaves in the fall and regrow them in the spring.During the dry season in a deciduous forest, trees shed their leaves to conserve water, they do not die off, but rather become dormant and regrow new foliage during the next suitable growing season.  the forest canopy becomes less dense,the plants under the canopy may experience increased sunlight exposure, and the ground becomes drier and potentially more susceptible to wildfires.
